status: analytic same-apparatus reconstruction at the published 30-microeV neutron point

source.title: Constraints on Axion Mediated Dipole-Dipole Interactions

reconstruction.reason: the same measured field, source, geometry and dipole potential are used for neutron and proton interpretations
reconstruction.qualification: reconstruction from rounded spin fractions and the published neutron point; it is a single-point analytic estimate, not an author-supplied numerical curve

decision: The reconstructed proton point is about 14.48 times weaker in the coupling product and 14.5 times weaker in A/|c_e c_N| than the neutron point. It supplies the proton row of flavor tomography but does not improve the universal benchmark or lift the three-flavor kernel.
